classes.changed.doc: The file class table changed (every session).

dupes.cleanup_cancel.doc: Stop once the step in progress is done.

dupes.cleanup_close.doc: Leave the plan; its edits are saved.

dupes.cleanup_edit.doc: Apply an edit (refused with a reason, or when base_version is not the plan's); clears an approval.

dupes.cleanup_execute.doc: Run the approved steps (the token must be the plan's): preflight first, then step by step.

dupes.cleanup_export.doc: Write the plan or a run's report (JSON, CSV).

dupes.cleanup_facets.doc: Counts per facet of a filter.

dupes.cleanup_preflight.doc: Check every step again without changing anything.

dupes.cleanup_preview.doc: What an edit would change, without keeping it.

dupes.cleanup_purge.doc: Empty the recovery area of a run for good, after a 5 s delay (cancellable) and checking each original.

dupes.cleanup_purge_plan.doc: Which originals can be purged, and why not.

dupes.cleanup_recover_report.doc: What finishing an interrupted run found at start.

dupes.cleanup_resolve.doc: Settle an item that needs the user.

dupes.cleanup_resume.doc: Take or drop the saved edits of an earlier plan.

dupes.cleanup_risk_copies.doc: The copies of one risk kind (paged).

dupes.cleanup_summary.doc: Per action, per volume, risk buckets, gates.

dupes.cleanup_undo.doc: Undo a run (or some of it).

dupes.cleanup_undo_plan.doc: What undoing a run would do, item by item.

dupes.cleanup_who_uses.doc: Programs holding the filtered copies open.

dupes.clear.doc: Forget a search and its results.

dupes.folder.doc: A folder's extra copies and what of it exists elsewhere (information only, never a delete).

dupes.locate.doc: Rows of a view's last frame that show or hold the copies of a group (lighting them up).

dupes.pause.doc: Pause the search: every file handle is closed.

dupes.plan.doc: What a duplicate-file search would read, from the scan alone (no IO).

dupes.status.doc: State, funnel, bytes read and ledger of a search.

ops.undo.doc: Undo a file operation: put trashed items back, or call off a permanent deletion still waiting.

scan.start.doc: Start scanning one or more roots.

settings.import.doc: Read a SpaceKnife settings export or a SpaceSniffer configuration: what would change, then apply it.

settings.reset.doc: Restore the defaults of one page, or of everything.

snapshot.load.doc: Open a snapshot as a finished scan.

snapshot.save.doc: Save a scan as a snapshot file.

system.maintenance.doc: Scan helper, cache, snapshots and saved tags (W7 高级).

tags.clear_saved.doc: Forget every remembered tag (all scan roots).

tree.find.doc: Look up a node by absolute path.

tree.node.doc: One node with its full path.

update.dismiss.doc: The card / dialog for this version was closed.

update.status.doc: What the last update check found (updates.v1).
